content: This document describes the software requirements for an online traffic news website (www.theaa.com)

The function of this website is to provide online news of traffic and traffic alert to all the drivers using theaa to save there time by avoiding traffic that to without installing those applications on their computers or cellphone

Online traffic news does not work alone there are lots of factors affecting it like internet connectivity without it- no news , traffic alerts , the gps (to know the location of the member) of the user will be fetched from servers or database to generate the traffic news . Different interfaces for different work are being clearly specified.

The user interface must fulfil ergonomic requirements of online traffic news. User can interact via keyboard or mouse and pressing of any wrong key will prompt an error message that wrong key pressed. Also the user interface must be interactive withtraffic news booking hotels and booking cabs. The website must also provide some videos on home screen how to get started.

The software must have to provide interfaces to following hardware:

Webcam
Pointing devices and keyboard
Connectivity through various interface cards for network connectivity

The online traffic news have to provide software interfaces to following:
Running on every version of windows Operating System.
Also able to run on mac operating system
The main working of online traffic news is only possible if a device is connected to the internet.

The software should contain a capability to connect to database using internet and the devices on which it is being installed must also contain internet connectivity. The software must be connected to the servers and the database always. There must not be any single version of software for different devices different versions must be available.

There are several users of online traffic news:
Members: The person who has joined the website or is a verified member of our software.
DBA: A dba is a user who has access to all the software and provides access to other users
Maintainer: Maintainer is a user of software who maintains the websites, report bugs and also upload new design or any new feature whenever needed. Also report errors to maintenance team.
